biggest_catch: Network coverage is limited to five states (Florida, Nevada, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia), and income scales purely with signing volume — per-signing pay ($5 basic / $25 real-estate closing) means nothing is guaranteed and idle time earns nothing.
catches: Only available to notaries in Florida, Nevada, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Virginia.
Pay is per completed signing: $5 basic notarization, $25 online real-estate closing — income depends entirely on assigned volume.
Signing volume is not guaranteed; availability of assignments varies.
The separate bring-your-own-customer model ($10 plus $3/additional seal) is a different product and must not be mixed into this fee-free network route.
